title: surveySystem document
description: A widget document of surveySystem: one root widget and its slot children. Structure only; compile the Blueprint for the authoritative diagnostics.

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

config.description: How the survey is titled and where it is sent.

header.description: Anything shown above the questions. Expects any widget.

questions.description: The questions, in order. Every question exposes whether it was answered. Expects Rating or Choice with the members { properties: { answered: boolean; }; }.

footer.description: Closing notes shown under the questions. Expects Note.

widget_Survey.description: A survey: a header, the questions in order, and a footer note. The root of a survey document. It counts the answered questions through the `questions` contract.

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

scale.description: The highest value of the scale; the lowest is 1.

widget_Rating.description: A rating question: pick a number on a scale.

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

options.description: The options, in the order shown.

multiple.description: Whether more than one option may be chosen.

followUp.description: A question shown once this one is answered. Must be the id of a widget of type Rating | Choice in the same document.

widget_Choice.description: A choice question: pick one or more options.

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

config.description: The text of the note. Leave the config out for an empty note.

id.description: The option's identifier, unique within the question.

label.description: The label shown for the option.

type_ChoiceOption.description: One option of a choice question.

type_I18nText.description: Text per language, keyed by language tag (`en`, `zh-TW`). At least one language should be present; the renderer falls back to the first one.

total.description: How many questions the survey has.

type_SubmitSummary.description: What `Survey.submit()` reports when the survey is sent.

maxQuestions.description: The most questions the survey may hold.

type_SurveyRawConfig.description: The raw config of a survey.
